name: Emberkit
title: Ember Kit
description: The fiery form of Vixi, warm enough to keep a laptop toasty.
catchphrase: Tucks tiny warm paws close to the terminal's glowing prompt.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Warm spiced milk with honey! Tiny fiery tail sparks happily! 🥛🔥
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Tiny fiery kitten stretch, little claws kneading the desk mat! 🔥
companionPersonality.petReaction: Curling right across your mousepad, purring like a warm toaster! 🔥💖

dialogue.idle: Sleeping curled up right under the warm exhaust fan. 🔥
dialogue.working: Warming the terminal prompt with friendly little sparks! 🔥⚡
dialogue.thinking: Tiny head tilts, watching cursor blink with kitten wonder... 🤔
dialogue.success: TINY MEOW ROAR! Sparks fly in sweet kitten celebration! 🔥🎉
dialogue.error: Sneezed a little smoke puff! Blinking big amber eyes! 💨
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... snoozing warm and cozy beside the laptop charger... 🌙
